name: manual_b615b1
claim: A mutant that survives is a missing test, not a pass: a compare-and-set guard survived mutation until a race test injected a competing recoverer between snapshot and takeover.

decisions.notes: No-CAS and no-winner-return mutants both passed the suite until two injected-race tests were added.

rationale: No-CAS and no-winner-return mutants both passed the suite until two injected-race tests were added.
